summary: refactor(shared): move STRIPE_PRICE_METADATA into subscriptions plan config
description:
Because:

- subscriptions/configuration/plan.ts imported STRIPE_PRICE_METADATA from
  payments/stripe.ts, which blocks moving subscriptions into a lib.

This commit:

- Moves the enum unchanged into subscriptions/configuration/plan.ts.
- Re-exports it from payments/stripe.ts, so no caller changes.
- Adds a mocha case that both exports are the same object.

Closes FXA-14712
